name: Nebula Hearts
source:
Awaken to chaos aboard a drifting spaceship, where you navigate playful banter with your quirky crew. Choose your words wisely and confront the unknown – will you forge bonds or reveal hidden secrets?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一覺醒來，你發現自己身處一艘在太空中漂流的太空船，船上一片混亂。你和個性古怪的船員們打趣鬥嘴，小心斟酌著言辭，一同面對未知。你會和他們結下羈絆，還是揭開那些埋藏的秘密？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
